subject: Request to pause demo — internal priority shift toward infra
messages:
From: Priya Rao <priya.rao@novaprospect.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood intro + demo (Nov 24) — quick update

Jordan —

Thanks again for setting up the walkthrough for Tuesday. I wanted to give you a quick heads-up: leadership just reprioritized a few engineering initiatives this week and pulled the LLM/serving work into a later phase. The infra org will absorb the majority of budget and engineering time for Q4, and our CTO is traveling frequently through Dec, so we don’t have the right stakeholders available for a productive demo next week.

I’m sorry for the late notice. Can we pause the scheduled demo and revisit after the holidays? Mid-January or early February would be better from our side. In the meantime, would you be able to share a short recorded demo and a one-page performance summary I can forward to the infra leads? That will help them evaluate cost/latency tradeoffs without pulling more people into meetings right now.

I attached a short internal note that explains the reallocation (internal-prioritization-note.pdf) so you have context on what they’re focusing on.

Appreciate your flexibility — Priya
Senior PM, NovaProspect

Hi Priya —

Totally understand — thanks for letting us know and for the context. We can pause Tuesday’s slot. No problem on the short notice.

To keep things moving without pulling more calendar time from your team, I’ll send: 1) a 12-minute recorded demo focused on throughput and latency, 2) a one-page performance summary tailored to infra decision criteria (cost / p95 / scaling characteristics), and 3) an updated mutual action plan you can share with the infra leads.

If mid-Jan / early-Feb is the right window, would you prefer I propose two 30-minute options around the weeks of Jan 11 and Jan 25 and leave them as tentative holds? Or would you rather we skip calendar holds and I ping you in early Jan to set a fresh time once you’ve had a chance to align internally?

Also — are the right infra stakeholders the CTO (Alex Gordon) and the Head of Platform (you can confirm)? If Alex will be on the thread, I can add a very short tech note that highlights GPU/quantization tradeoffs specific to your deployment models.

I’ll attach the assets here for easy forwarding. Let me know what you prefer and I’ll send the recording link and MAP.

Thanks — Jordan
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
redwood.ai | (415) 555-0182

From: Priya Rao <priya.rao@novaprospect.com>

Cc: Alex Gordon <alex.gordon@novaprospect.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 11:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood intro + demo (Nov 24) — quick update

Jordan —

Thanks, that sounds perfect. Alex is the right call — looping him so you have a contact on the infra side. We’d prefer not to put tentative holds on calendars while we finish the budget rework; we’ll reach out in early Jan to lock a slot.

Please send the recording and the one-pager; I’ll pass them to Alex and the platform leads. If possible, include a short section that compares running an inference stack in-hosted vs dedicated vs private (VPC) — that’s the question the platform team will want to see up front.

No attachments from our side beyond the internal note. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Priya

On a side note: there’s still interest after this reallocation — it’s a scope/timing shift rather than a hard “no.”

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>

Priya / Alex —

Thanks — attaching the items we discussed:
- redwood-demo-recording.mp4 (12:07) — short walkthrough of hosted vs dedicated vs VPC with latency/cost callouts
- redwood-mutual-action-plan-v2.pdf — lightweight MAP and proposed milestones you can share with Platform
- one-page-performance-summary.txt (included in the MAP PDF as the executive summary)

A couple quick asks to make the follow-up efficient:
1) When you’re ready, would Jan 11–15 or Jan 25–29 work better for a 30-minute sync? We’ll propose both windows and you can pick.
2) If Alex or the platform team would like a very short technical brief (1 page) about quantization/throughput tradeoffs we can prepare that by Dec 10 — would that be helpful to the infra leads while they finalize budgets?

I’ve linked the HubSpot deal for reference: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/NP-2026-087. I’ll mark the opportunity as paused internally and set a reminder to follow up in early Jan so nothing slips.

No calendar holds per your ask — we’ll wait for you to pick a slot. If it helps, I can also send a one-paragraph summary you can paste into your internal prioritization doc.

Appreciate you looping Alex. We’ll be here as soon as you’re ready.

Best — Jordan
